mapper.sql: with qualified_presence as ( select e.customer_id customerId,e.session_id sessionId, min(coalesce(from_unixtime(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.firstSeenAt')) as unsigned)/1000),e.occurred_at)) firstAt, max(e.occurred_at) activityAt, greatest(max(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.watchSeconds')) as unsigned)),300) watchSeconds from dy_audience_v2_ingest_batch b straight_join dy_audience_v2_interaction_event e force index (idx_av2_event_batch) on e.ingest_batch_id=b.id join dy_audience_v2_live_session s on s.id=e.session_id where cast(substring_index(b.plugin_version,'.',1) as unsigned)>=3 and e.event_type='VIEWER' and e.occurred_at>=#{beginAt} and e.occurred_at<#{endAt} and json_valid(e.payload_json) and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.watchSeconds')) as unsigned)>=300 and s.room_name_key=#{roomNameKey} group by e.customer_id,e.session_id ), activity_rows as ( select e.customer_id customerId,e.session_id sessionId,e.occurred_at firstAt,e.occurred_at activityAt, 1 commentCount,0 watchSeconds,e.id commentEventId from dy_audience_v2_interaction_event e join dy_audience_v2_live_session s on s.id=e.session_id where e.event_type='COMMENT' and e.occurred_at>=#{beginAt} and e.occurred_at<#{endAt} and s.room_name_key=#{roomNameKey} union all select p.customerId,p.sessionId,p.firstAt,p.activityAt, 0 commentCount,least(p.watchSeconds,21600) watchSeconds,null commentEventId from qualified_presence p ), activity as ( select customerId, cast(substring_index(group_concat(sessionId order by activityAt desc separator ','),',',1) as unsigned) sessionId, min(firstAt) firstInteractionAt,max(activityAt) lastInteractionAt, sum(commentCount) commentCount,count(distinct sessionId) visitCount,sum(watchSeconds) watchSeconds, cast(substring_index(group_concat(commentEventId order by activityAt desc,commentEventId desc separator ','),',',1) as unsigned) lastCommentId from activity_rows group by customerId ), latest_opportunity as ( select ranked.* from ( select o.*,row_number() over(partition by o.customer_id order by o.id desc) rowNo from dy_audience_v2_opportunity o ) ranked where ranked.rowNo=1 ), latest_task as ( select ranked.* from ( select t.*,row_number() over(partition by o.customer_id order by t.id desc) rowNo,o.customer_id from dy_audience_v2_followup_task t join dy_audience_v2_opportunity o on o.id=t.opportunity_id where t.status not in ('DONE','RELEASED') ) ranked where ranked.rowNo=1 ), latest_order as ( select ranked.* from ( select ol.*,row_number() over(partition by ol.customer_id order by ol.id desc) rowNo from dy_audience_v2_order_link ol ) ranked where ranked.rowNo=1 )

c.id customerId,c.display_name nickname,c.douyin_account douyinAccount,c.phone,c.wechat, (select i.sec_uid from dy_audience_v2_identity i where i.customer_id=c.id and i.sec_uid is not null and i.sec_uid!='' and i.sec_uid not like 'dom:%' order by i.last_seen_at desc,i.id desc limit 1) secUid, coalesce(o.consult_stage,c.consult_stage) stage,c.interaction_status interactionStatus,c.fan_status fanStatus, coalesce(c.owner_user_id,o.owner_user_id) ownerUserId, coalesce(nullif(ou.nick_name,''),c.owner_name,o.owner_name) ownerName, a.sessionId,a.firstInteractionAt,a.lastInteractionAt,a.commentCount,a.lastCommentId,a.visitCount,a.watchSeconds, s.room_name roomName,s.live_date liveDate,o.id opportunityId,o.special_mark specialMark, o.controller_user_id controllerUserId,o.controller_name controllerName, coalesce(o.controller_first_followup_at,o.first_followed_at) controllerFirstFollowupAt, coalesce(o.controller_first_followup_user_id,o.controller_user_id,o.owner_user_id) controllerFirstFollowupUserId, coalesce(o.controller_first_followup_name,o.controller_name,o.owner_name) controllerFirstFollowupName, t.id taskId,t.task_type taskType,t.task_date taskDate, case when t.status='PENDING' and t.task_date<current_date then 'OVERDUE' else t.status end taskStatus, t.assignee_user_id taskAssigneeUserId,t.assignee_name taskAssigneeName, ol.id orderId,ol.order_no orderNo,ol.order_status orderStatus, (select group_concat(distinct nullif(trim(eol.order_no),'') order by eol.id separator '；') from dy_audience_v2_order_link eol where eol.customer_id=c.id) orderNos, (select count(*) from dy_audience_v2_attachment ea where ea.customer_id=c.id and ea.status='READY') screenshotCount

from activity a join dy_audience_v2_customer c on c.id=a.customerId join dy_audience_v2_live_session s on s.id=a.sessionId left join latest_opportunity o on o.customer_id=c.id left join sys_user ou on ou.user_id=coalesce(c.owner_user_id,o.owner_user_id) left join latest_task t on t.customer_id=c.id left join latest_order ol on ol.customer_id=c.id

where.if: and (c.display_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.douyin_account like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.phone like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.wechat like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or exists ( select 1 from dy_audience_v2_interaction_event ke join dy_audience_v2_live_session ks on ks.id=ke.session_id where ke.customer_id=c.id and ke.event_type='COMMENT' and ke.occurred_at>=#{beginAt} and ke.occurred_at<#{endAt} and ke.content like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') and ks.room_name_key=#{roomNameKey} ))

mapper.select:
select /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(5000) */ count(*) over() totalCount,
order by a.lastInteractionAt desc,c.id desc limit #{offset},#{limit}

select /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(5000) */ count(*) validCustomers, sum(a.commentCount>0) commentedCustomers, sum(a.commentCount=0 and a.watchSeconds>=300) viewerCustomers, sum(coalesce(c.owner_user_id,o.owner_user_id) is null) unclaimed, sum(coalesce(c.owner_user_id,o.owner_user_id) is not null) claimed, sum(a.commentCount>0 and coalesce(c.owner_user_id,o.owner_user_id) is null) unclaimedCommented, sum(a.commentCount>0 and coalesce(c.owner_user_id,o.owner_user_id) is not null) claimedCommented, sum(coalesce(o.consult_stage,c.consult_stage)='CONSULTING') consulting, sum(coalesce(o.consult_stage,c.consult_stage)='ORDERED' or ol.id is not null) ordered, sum(coalesce(o.controller_first_followup_at,o.first_followed_at) is not null) controllerFollowed, round(avg(case when coalesce(o.controller_first_followup_at,o.first_followed_at)>=a.firstInteractionAt then timestampdiff(minute,a.firstInteractionAt,coalesce(o.controller_first_followup_at,o.first_followed_at)) end),1) avgFirstResponseMinutes

select coalesce(c.owner_user_id,o.owner_user_id) ownerUserId, coalesce(nullif(ou.nick_name,''),c.owner_name,o.owner_name,'待领取') ownerName,count(*) customerCount, sum(a.commentCount>0) commentedCount, sum(coalesce(o.consult_stage,c.consult_stage)='CONSULTING') consultingCount, sum(coalesce(o.consult_stage,c.consult_stage)='ORDERED' or ol.id is not null) orderedCount
where coalesce(c.owner_user_id,o.owner_user_id) is not null group by coalesce(c.owner_user_id,o.owner_user_id),coalesce(nullif(ou.nick_name,''),c.owner_name,o.owner_name,'待领取') order by orderedCount desc,customerCount desc limit 50

with commented_customer as ( select s.room_name_key roomNameKey,s.room_name roomName,e.customer_id customerId, count(*) commentCount,max(e.occurred_at) lastReportedAt from dy_audience_v2_interaction_event e join dy_audience_v2_live_session s on s.id=e.session_id where e.event_type='COMMENT' and e.occurred_at>=#{beginAt} and e.occurred_at<#{endAt} and s.room_name_key=#{roomNameKey} group by s.room_name_key,s.room_name,e.customer_id ), latest_opportunity as ( select ranked.* from ( select o.*,row_number() over(partition by o.customer_id order by o.id desc) rowNo from dy_audience_v2_opportunity o ) ranked where ranked.rowNo=1 ) select cc.roomName,count(*) reportedCustomers,sum(cc.commentCount) uploadedComments, sum(coalesce(o.owner_user_id,c.owner_user_id) is not null) claimedCustomers, sum(coalesce(o.owner_user_id,c.owner_user_id) is null) unclaimedCustomers, max(cc.lastReportedAt) lastReportedAt from commented_customer cc join dy_audience_v2_customer c on c.id=cc.customerId left join latest_opportunity o on o.customer_id=c.id group by cc.roomNameKey,cc.roomName order by reportedCustomers desc,lastReportedAt desc
